meta.name: FIFA+
meta.description:
Bringing fans into the heart of football with the iconic World Cup Archive, Live football from around the globe and documentaries bring the stories behind the beautiful game.

Shows: China PR v Haiti | Group D | FIFA Women's World Cup Australia & New Zealand 2023™ | Full Match Replay, The Best of FIFA World Cup Korea & Japan 2002™, Argentina v Serbia and Montenegro | Group C | 2006 FIFA World Cup Germany™ | Full Match Replay, FACTS: Brazil v France | France 98, USA v Thailand | Group F | FIFA Women's World Cup France 2019™ | Full Match Replay
Available on: Samsung TV Plus, Plex
